limits: CPU elapsed contains original native API calls and possible waits; no GPU activity union measured.
Parent range-loop includes children. Only parent exclusive control plus child buckets may be summed.
Mode is requested mode, not proof of selected route. Original prepared replay and actual record/reuse facts remain authoritative.
Normal exit and all counts/masks/overflow were checked. Clock overhead is not calibrated; timings are diagnostic, not a benchmark.
No additional Model/GPU/compile/profiler process was launched to repair the initial offline Commands-mask assertion.
No throughput, current-vs-peer unit-cost, pure CPU or recoverable-time claim; no benchmark samples were added.
prepare_replay excludes preceding Model layout/batch/input work. Same-call cold_batch minus prepare_replay is an unclassified upper-level envelope, printed at finite clock precision.

Dispatch covers all selected region/operation/copy steps; it is not equivalent to ggml provider time or kernel-launch time. End combines native capture/update-or-instantiation and artifact lifetime work; no exact Update/Instantiate counts were measured.
